title.narrative: To have a comprehensive stakeholders mapping, the team developed a template to use as a guiding criteria for engagement. There was a detailed nation wide stakeholders mapping for all 16 regions to identify key horticulture stakeholders in the country. IDH focused on 8 regions in the northern part of Ghana and HBP focused on the southern part of Ghana and stakeholders mapping was done concurrently. The mapping identified almost all the relevant actors in the sector which included the following, producers, farmer groups, service providers, market queens, traders, processors, off-takers, input suppliers, mechanization service providers, digital solution providers, researchers, Agric state agencies, regulatory state agencies. At the end of the horticultural stakeholders mapping there were over 345 players identified in the horticultural sector with 180 players located in the southern part of Ghana and the remaining 165 located in the northern part of Ghana.
